require 'faye/websocket'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'base64'
require 'redis'
require 'securerandom'

module SessionCrypto
  ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-cbc'
  
  def self.derive_key(master_secret, salt)
    OpenSSL::PKCS5.pbkdf2_hmac(master_secret, salt, 10000, 32, 'sha256')
  end

  def self.encrypt_session(payload, master_secret)
    salt = SecureRandom.random_bytes(16)
    key = derive_key(master_secret, salt)
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
    cipher.encrypt
    cipher.key = key
    iv = cipher.random_iv
    encrypted = cipher.update(payload.to_json) + cipher.final
    hmac = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', key, salt + iv + encrypted)
    Base64.urlsafe_encode64(salt + iv + hmac + encrypted)
  end

  def self.decrypt_session(token, master_secret)
    raw = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(token)
    salt = raw[0, 16]
    iv = raw[16, 16]
    hmac_received = raw[32, 32]
    ciphertext = raw[64..]
    
    key = derive_key(master_secret, salt)
    hmac_computed = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('sha256', key, salt + iv + ciphertext)
    
    unless secure_compare(hmac_received, hmac_computed)
      return { error: 'integrity_check_failed', code: 'HMAC_MISMATCH' }
    end

    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
    cipher.decrypt
    cipher.key = key
    cipher.iv = iv
    
    begin
      decrypted = cipher.update(ciphertext) + cipher.final
      JSON.parse(decrypted)
    rescue OpenSSL::Cipher::CipherError => e
      { error: 'decryption_failed', code: 'PADDING_ERROR' }
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      { error: 'parse_failed', code: 'INVALID_JSON' }
    end
  end

  def self.secure_compare(a, b)
    return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
    result = 0
    a.bytes.zip(b.bytes) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
    result == 0
  end
end

class K8sWebSocketHandler
  MASTER_SECRET = ENV.fetch('SESSION_MASTER_SECRET', 'k8s-default-secret-change-me')
  RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 60
  MAX_REQUESTS = 100

  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
    @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://localhost:6379'))
    @connections = {}
  end

  def call(env)
    if Faye::WebSocket.websocket?(env)
      ws = Faye::WebSocket.new(env)
      connection_id = SecureRandom.uuid
      
      ws.on :open do |event|
        @connections[connection_id] = { ws: ws, authenticated: false, opened_at: Time.now }
      end

      ws.on :message do |event|
        handle_message(connection_id, event.data)
      end

      ws.on :close do |event|
        @connections.delete(connection_id)
      end

      ws.rack_response
    else
      @app.call(env)
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_message(connection_id, raw_data)
    conn = @connections[connection_id]
    return unless conn

    begin
      message = JSON.parse(raw_data)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      send_error(conn[:ws], 'INVALID_FORMAT', 'Message must be valid JSON')
      return
    end

    case message['action']
    when 'authenticate'
      handle_auth(conn, message)
    when 'refresh_session'
      handle_refresh(conn, message)
    when 'query'
      handle_query(conn, message)
    else
      send_error(conn[:ws], 'UNKNOWN_ACTION', 'Unrecognized action')
    end
  end

  def handle_auth(conn, message)
    token = message['token']
    unless token.is_a?(String) && token.length > 0 && token.length < 4096
      send_error(conn[:ws], 'INVALID_TOKEN', 'Token format invalid')
      return
    end

    result = SessionCrypto.decrypt_session(token, MASTER_SECRET)
    
    if result.is_a?(Hash) && result['error']
      send_response(conn[:ws], {
        status: 'auth_failed',
        reason: result['code']
      })
      return
    end

    if result.is_a?(Hash) && result['user_id'] && result['exp']
      if result['exp'].to_i > Time.now.to_i
        conn[:authenticated] = true
        conn[:user_id] = result['user_id']
        send_response(conn[:ws], { status: 'authenticated', user: result['user_id'] })
      else
        send_response(conn[:ws], { status: 'auth_failed', reason: 'TOKEN_EXPIRED' })
      end
    else
      send_response(conn[:ws], { status: 'auth_failed', reason: 'INVALID_PAYLOAD' })
    end
  end

  def handle_refresh(conn, message)
    unless conn[:authenticated]
      send_error(conn[:ws], 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'Must authenticate first')
      return
    end

    old_token = message['old_token']
    validation = SessionCrypto.decrypt_session(old_token, MASTER_SECRET)
    
    if validation.is_a?(Hash) && validation['error']
      error_detail = case validation['code']
                     when 'HMAC_MISMATCH'
                       'Token integrity verification failed'
                     when 'PADDING_ERROR'
                       'Token structure is corrupted'
                     when 'INVALID_JSON'
                       'Token payload is malformed'
                     else
                       'Unknown validation error'
                     end
      send_response(conn[:ws], {
        status: 'refresh_failed',
        error_code: validation['code'],
        detail: error_detail
      })
    else
      new_payload = { 'user_id' => conn[:user_id], 'exp' => Time.now.to_i + 3600 }
      new_token = SessionCrypto.encrypt_session(new_payload, MASTER_SECRET)
      send_response(conn[:ws], { status: 'refreshed', token: new_token })
    end
  end

  def handle_query(conn, message)
    unless conn[:authenticated]
      send_error(conn[:ws], 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'Must authenticate first')
      return
    end
    send_response(conn[:ws], { status: 'ok', data: { pod: ENV['HOSTNAME'], user: conn[:user_id] } })
  end

  def send_response(ws, payload)
    ws.send(payload.to_json)
  end

  def send_error(ws, code, message)
    ws.send({ status: 'error', code: code, message: message }.to_json)
  end
end
